report:
All source diffs check out. Now let me verify the build and the dist artifacts.

## Audit Report

**Objective:** "complete and verify" — the executor's own scope document (`PUNCHLIST-FIXES-PLAN.md`) defines the deliverable as the full UI/UX punchlist: 6 P0 bugs, 6 P1 UX issues, 8 P2 polish items, plus cheap tech-debt wins, all verified against a production build.

**Method:** Reviewed all 8 modified source files via `git diff`, rebuilt from scratch (`npm run build`), grepped `dist/` output, ran a preview-server smoke test, and pixel-decoded the generated PNGs. No files were mutated.

### Evidence verified (all pass)

**P0:** Hero text split into two proper `.display__support` sentences with spacing rule added ✓ · `isExternal()` helper means `#reading`/`#podcast` project cards carry no `target="_blank"` (confirmed in built HTML; external cards still open new tabs) ✓ · Rickroll `dQw4w9WgXcQ` gone everywhere in `dist/`; SuretyDoc → `Retired` with empty href rendering as a `<div class="project-card project-card--plain">`; Storybloom → `Deprecated` ✓ · No-JS fallback real: inline head script adds `.js` pre-paint, reveal hidden state gated behind `html.js .reveal`, `<noscript>` forces `.reveal` visible ✓ · Nav close now calls `toggle.focus()` (was hidden `.site-nav__email`) ✓ · LastFm initial markup is "Loading / Fetching the stream…", with "Offline" only in the fetch-catch path ✓

**P1:** `<LastFm variant="section">` renders in `#listening` (`listening-widget--section bento__span-5` in dist) and Elsewhere card is `bento__span-7` ✓ · all `.reading-grid li:hover` rules removed (0 matches in built CSS) ✓ · ChatWidget has `aria-live="polite"`, animated typing indicator + `chatTyping` keyframes, input/send disabled while pending, Escape closes and refocuses toggle ✓ · `--accent-ink` tokens (`#9c360f` dark / `#b33f00` light) applied to the failing orange-on-cream elements (I computed ~5.6:1 vs the old ~2.3:1) and `--subtle` bumped 0.45→0.6 / 0.48→0.62 ✓ · `og-image.png` 1200×630 and `apple-touch-icon.png` 180×180 exist, are referenced in `og:image`/`twitter:image`/`apple-touch-icon`, and I decoded pixels: og-image dark corners (#030303) + cream center (#efe5cf), apple-touch-icon dark corners/cream center with accent-orange mid-top ✓

**P2:** `◐` glyph in built CSS ✓ · socials `tag` labels rendered from data ✓ · referral labels trimmed (`Buffer (Social Media X-Posting)` → `Buffer`, etc.) ✓ · project-card hover `padding-inline: 0.8rem` jump removed (translateX retained) ✓ · 404 arrow `←` ✓ · focus-visible added for `.principle-trigger`, `.principle-modal__close`, `.hero__meta a` ✓ · iframe dropped `frameborder`/`scrolling`/`width` ✓ · `theme-color` meta updates dynamically in both the head script and the theme toggle ✓

**Tech debt:** `principles` consolidated into `src/data/site.ts` and imported by both the frontmatter and client script (no duplication) ✓ · Google Fonts URL trimmed to used weights ✓

**Verification claims cross-checked:** `npm run build` succeeds (3 pages, zero errors) ✓ · all dist greps reproduced ✓ · preview smoke test: `/`, `/privacy`, `/404.html`, `/og-image.png`, `/apple-touch-icon.png`, `/robots.txt`, `/sitemap.xml` all 200 ✓ · PNG pixel claims reproduced programmatically ✓ · exactly 8 files changed, matching the claim ✓

### Caveats (non-blocking)
- The deferrals (CSS layer consolidation, `tmp-new-site-snapshot.txt`, reading-list search/filter) are transparently documented in the plan with rationale and disclosed in the completion claim — an explicit, honest scope boundary, not a hidden omission.
- `astro preview` returns 404 for `/privacy/` with a trailing slash (200 without it); internal links use `/privacy`, and this is preview-server URL normalization rather than a punchlist defect.
- Minor: CSS uses `font-weight: 750`, which isn't among the loaded Geist weights (browser-synthesized; cosmetic only).

**Verdict:** Every punchlist item claimed is genuinely implemented, present in the production build output, and backed by reproducible verification. The work is a real, final-quality fix set rather than a scaffold or proxy milestone.
